children: Industrial production in Hungary increased 4.7% year-on-year in July 2026, easing from the 10.1% growth recorded in June.

The slowdown was mainly reflected in manufacturing (4.9% vs 10.8% in June), wherein transport equipment manufacturing (18.0% vs 21.0%) and computer, electronic and optical products (19.7% vs 49.7%) eased but remained a key source of growth.
In contrast, chemicals and chemical products accelerated (15.0% vs. 12.6%), as did coke and refined petroleum products (7.2% vs. 5.4%).
Meanwhile, food, beverages and tobacco products remained in contraction (-2.3% vs. -1.5%), while electrical equipment deteriorated further (-6.0% vs. 1.8%).
On a seasonally and working-day adjusted monthly basis, industrial output rose 1.7% in July, reversing a 1.4% decline in June.
Over the first seven months of 2026, industrial production was 2.7% higher than in the same period of 2025.

title: Hungary Industrial Output Slows Sharply in July
